# conan-proxy (conan proxy) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository
# note: official Conan 2 authentication requires an independent GATEWAY_CONAN_TOKEN_SECRET on the server; use a local service-account or resolver credential

## add remote
conan remote add conan-proxy http://gateway.test/gw/conan/conan-proxy

## sign in
conan remote login conan-proxy ci -p "$ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN"
